description: Creates a music generation task using Suno. Returns a task ID for polling.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional retry key; see the idempotency guide.

audio_operation.description: upload-extend needs continue_at; add-instrumental needs audio_url/title/tags/negative_tags.

audio_url.description: Public audio URL; omitted audio_operation defaults to upload-cover.

continue_at.description: Continuation time in seconds; required for upload-extend.

continue_clip_id.description: Clip ID to continue when extending an existing generation. To set new lyrics with prompt, also send…

mv.description: Suno model version; required for MUSIC/default action, omitted for lyrics-only.

negative_tags.description: Styles to avoid. Required when audio_operation is add-instrumental.

prompt.description: Prompt required for music/lyrics/upload-cover/upload-extend; omit for add-instrumental.
